name: striatin

function.text: STRN encodes striatin. Annotated molecular activities include protein-macromolecule adaptor activity and calmodulin binding. It participates in regulation of signal transduction and dendrite development.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include ALK-rearranged renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
